citations.claim: Net quantity in both units, bottom 30%, type size and separation
citations.evidence: 101.7(f): the declaration "shall be separated (by at least a space equal to the height of the lettering used in the declaration) from other printed label information appearing above or below" and is placed "within the bottom 30 percent of the area of the label panel". 101.7(i)(3): "Not less than three-sixteenths inch in height on packages the principal display panel of which has an area of more than 25 but not more than 100 square inches" — 120 × 240 mm is 44.6 in², so 4.76 mm. 15 U.S.C. 1453(a)(2) (govinfo USCODE-2023): net quantity "shall be separately and accurately stated in a uniform location upon the principal display panel of that label, using the most appropriate units of both the customary inch/pound system of measure ... and, except as provided in paragraph (3)(A)(ii) or paragraph (6) of this subsection, the SI metric system"

citations.claim: Nutrients declared and ordered; serving size; type sizes
citations.evidence: 101.9(c): nutrient information "shall be presented using the nutrient names specified and in the following order"; (c)(8)(ii): the declaration "shall include vitamin D, calcium, iron, and potassium in that order". 101.9(d)(3)(ii): "“Serving size”: A statement of the serving size as specified in paragraph (b)(7) of this section which shall immediately follow the “____servings per container” declaration."

citations.claim: The % Daily Values match
citations.evidence: 101.9(d)(7)(ii): "A listing of the percent of the DRV as established in paragraphs (c)(7)(iii) and (c)(9) ... with the percent expressed to the nearest whole percent for each nutrient ... for which a DRV has been established". It covers the 7 DRV percentages only; the other 4 of the 11 (vitamin D, calcium, iron, potassium) are percents of an RDI, rounded under (c)(8)(iii) "to the nearest 2-percent increment up to and including the 10-percent level, the nearest 5-percent increment above 10 percent".
